lee (eng): Hey @olivia, quick question 39 my Feb paystubs still show US federal withholding only. I relocated to Dublin 2025-02-02 and uploaded passport + move form on 2025-01-30. Thought PAYE would apply. Can payroll confirm receipt?

olivia (people-ops): Thanks for flagging @lee. Can you share your employee ID and the folder where you uploaded docs? Ill escalate.

lee (eng): Employee ID 9912. Uploaded to relocations/lee-dub. Paystub snippet:```
Pay Date: 2025-02-28
Gross: $7,800.00
Federal: $1,560.00
Foreign Withholding: $0.00
Net: $6,240.00
```

matt (payroll): Matt from Payroll here. Looks like the residency flag didn't sync. Opening ticket GP-6920 to switch withholding to Irish PAYE/PRSI effective 2025-02-02 and run retro calc. Do you have a PPSN or want a temporary placeholder?

payroll-bot: Ticket GP-6920 created by matt (payroll) "International withholding update: lee (9912)". Priority: P2. Initial reply expected 1 business day.

katie (eng): I had a similar move; payroll applied PAYE mid-cycle then posted a single retro adjustment on next payrun. Keep an eye on net shortfall line.

matt (payroll): Next steps: 1) confirm PPSN or accept temp code, 2) confirm move date (lee: 2025-02-02), 3) well request retro figures and advise if any additional withholding or credit is due. Also confirming whether a corrected W-2 will be necessary for 2025; will update GP-6920 once tax advises.

lee (eng): PPSN app in progress. Confirm move-in date is 2025-02-02. Thanks for the quick help.

olivia (people-ops): Thanks all please keep updates in GP-6920 so we have a record for benefits and year-end docs.
